scope: External execution status and evidence boundary for the Hybrid TEE-Rollup revision run.

public_testnet.reason: No SEPOLIA_RPC_URL, SEPOLIA_PRIVATE_KEY, or deployed BLOB_BATCH_ANCHOR_ADDRESS was available. The publish script is fail-closed and was not allowed to broadcast.

offline_kzg.trusted_setup_description: Real Ethereum mainnet EIP-4844 KZG trusted setup; no mock cryptography.
checks: Content tampering rejected against the original commitment and proof
Recomputed commitment and proof validate the tampered blob itself
Payload hash changes after content tampering
Serialized blob tampering rejected against the original commitment and proof
Frame decoding and task-count semantics preserved for the original blob

independent_blob_fetch.reason: No BEACON_API_URL and no recorded publish state were available. No local artifact was substituted for a live fetch.
independent_blob_fetch.peer_das_constraint: After Fusaka/PeerDAS, a regular beacon node may not custody the full blob; use a supernode or a public endpoint that serves full sidecars.
required_to_resume: A confirmed publish state containing block number and blob versioned hash
BEACON_API_URL pointing to a full-blob beacon endpoint or Pinax-compatible endpoint

binding_gap.description: Offline KZG artifacts prove genuine blob encoding, commitments, proofs, decoding, and tamper detection, but do not prove that a public-chain transaction carried the blob or that BlobBatchAnchor recorded the corresponding versioned hash.
missing_evidence: On-chain versioned-hash, payload-hash, and task-count comparison

fee_independence.conclusion: The local performance run contains a calldata benchmark only. It must not be used to claim real EIP-4844 blob fee savings. A real blob fee comparison requires a confirmed type-3 Sepolia receipt and blob-gas fee fields.
fee_independence.performance_scope: Local Cancun Hardhat automining on chainId 31337; not public-chain throughput, consensus finality, or real blob pricing.

real_tee.reason: No cloud credentials or running TDX instance was available. No quote was fabricated and no cloud purchase or login was performed.
documentary_scope: TDX provider and supported instance family documented by official sources
Supported availability zones documented by official sources
Quote generation and DCAP/PCCS flow documented by official sources
Realtime price, inventory, quota, and minimum billing interval remain unverified
required_to_resume: User-provisioned TDX instance in a supported availability zone
Real TD Report/Quote with PCK certificate chain
Collateral: TCB Info, QE Identity, and PCK CRL
Measurement comparison against the deployed sequencer software
real_tee.continuation_notes: See audit/external_research/tee_precheck_quote.md for the official Quote collection and verification procedure.

limitations: Cross-protocol latency and cost numbers use different threat models and denominators and are not directly convertible into a single lead percentage.
Cloud price, inventory, quota, and minimum billing claims are not realtime-verified.
Sepolia/PeerDAS retrieval behavior requires a full-blob-capable beacon endpoint for live evidence.
